lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Mwahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Today is our scheduled meeting for the Villain Union.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hear me, all of you, and tremble with excitement!
All hail the world's greatest villain!
I can hardly wait!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Silence! I haven't even started yet.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You're embarrassing me.
Sorry.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: All right, I'll begin. A week ago,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I was walking around, seeing what trouble I could cause,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: when lo and behold, I found a wallet on the ground.
Did you take it for yourself?
Did you leave it?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Do you not know anything?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Taking someone else's property is the worst thing you can possibly do.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Of course not! If I did that, someone else could have taken it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I took it to the nearest police station.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: At this very moment,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: the owner is probably wandering the streets, unable to find it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Mwahahaha!
I'm sure they'll end up finding it eventually.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: If you think that's impressive, this will knock your socks off.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Actually, I'm debating whether I should tell you this or not.
What is it?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Just don't freak out.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Remember how we ran into each other yesterday?
Yes.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: And we had a pretty long conversation?
It was mostly you doing the talking, but sure.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Your fly was open the entire time.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Despite the inordinate amount of pleasure I get from seeing you so embarrassed,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: for the sake of everyone else around you,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I suggest you double-check your zipper next time you're in public.
... Noted.
